run_doctest_virtual_functions: run the doctest suite that tests Boost.Python virtual function override behavior for abstract and concrete C++ classes
create_concrete_subclass_with_override: create a Python subclass of the concrete C++ class that overrides method f to negate the Y value
create_abstract_subclass_with_override: create a Python subclass of the abstract C++ class that overrides methods f and g with custom logic
test_virtual_call_from_cpp: test calling overridden Python virtual methods indirectly from C++ via the call_f and call_g wrapper methods
review_virtual_override_behavior: review the Boost.Python virtual function override test module to understand abstract versus concrete subclass behavior
